instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: ConsentHarbor Withdrawal Ledger records study withdrawal requests, their coverage of future contact and sample collection, the stopping of covered new activities, linked-material inventories, proposed-handling rationales, and reviewed final instructions. Participants submit requests; Participant Liaisons record scope; Study Coordinators stop covered activities and send records to Data Custodians; Principal Investigators record rationales; and Ethics Reviewers record final instructions after reviewing the request, inventory, and rationale. The treatment of non-identifiable data after a destruction request is disputed. The identity-verification role and the maximum instruction-issuance time are also undecided.

output.summary: ConsentHarbor Withdrawal Ledger records study withdrawal requests and their scope, stops covered new activities, inventories linked materials, records proposed-handling rationales, and produces reviewed final instructions. Participants, Participant Liaisons, Study Coordinators, Data Custodians, Principal Investigators, and Ethics Reviewers perform the stated workflow responsibilities. Treatment of non-identifiable data after a destruction request remains disputed, while identity-verification responsibility and instruction timing are undecided.
output.primary_goal: Record study withdrawal requests, stop covered future activities, inventory linked research materials, and issue reviewed handling instructions.
key_capabilities: Record a withdrawal request and whether it covers future contact, future sample collection, or both.
Send withdrawal records to Data Custodians.
